title: Always caring attentive doctors
content: I know it’s difficult to get an appointment. This is and never has been the fault of any practice. For this we look to resources and funding. I have always found the GP’s, nurses and support staff talented and caring. I have visited today and not been disappointed. A very caring and interested GP. She had time and patience with a very caring attitude. I’m conscious not to take up too much time but I didn’t feel rushed at all. Kindness and compassion from all the staff who work under unimaginable stress and pressure.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
